content: We need number of carbonyl (C=O) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can use IR spectra to detect C=O stretch, or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). Use IR tool (cheaper than NMR?). Both are cheap but we should minimize. Probably IR is simplest: look for strong peak around 1700 cm-1. Use ir_spectra.
